_comment: MONSTER family manifest (Phase 3, 2026-08-14). One entry per validated family. hf_arch_strings = suffix-stripped family tags (see safetensors_reader.cpp) + HF class names; mapping_target = rcpp_arch_t token; quirk_flags = what backend_generic must handle; e2e_model = HF repo for the real-checkpoint gate; oracle = GGUF for tokenize/detokenize parity. Status: validated | in_progress | pending.

quirk_flags.gguf: no norm tensors; unrotate q/k (llama.cpp pre-rotates)

quirk_flags.attn: fused query_key_value [H+2HD,H] MQA split cols, 1 kv head

families.e2e_model: tiiuae/falcon-7b (7.2GB, auto_map stripped for torch oracle)

families.result: 20/20 identical vs llama.cpp Q8; reader needed num_layers fallback

quirk_flags.ffn: down = w2(silu(w1 x)*(w3 x)) — w2 is DOWN, w1/w3 up

families.result: engine ≡ authoritative modeling_internlm2.py numpy EXACT; vs Q8 oracle near-tie top-3 (the/a/Paris within 0.5 logits) — Q8 drift pattern

quirk_flags.bug_fixed: gated dense FFN residual was UNSCALED — fixed 2026-08-14

families.oracle: llamacpp Q8 sft (UNRELIABLE — llama.cpp treats minicpm as plain llama, ignores scale quirks)
families.result: engine ≡ authoritative openbmb modeling numpy EXACT (top-6 logits identical); llama.cpp oracle disagrees because it misses scale_emb/scale_depth/logits_scaling

quirk_flags.limitation: heterogeneous per-layer heads/ffn + fused qkv_proj + per-head q/k_norm + transformer.token_embeddings naming — does NOT fit the uniform generic engine (pilot #14 confirmed 2026-08-14)

families.result: refuses loudly at load ('missing embedding'); needs bespoke path — out of generic-engine scope

VALIDATED 2026-08-15 (commit pending): engine ≡ f32 numpy port of authoritative modeling_deepseek.py (+ llama.cpp deepseek2.cpp conventions) at ALL 27 layers and multi-position attention (max|diff| ~0.01-0.9 = f16 expert storage; layers 0-2 exact). Correct next-token behavior on the natural prompt (predicts fox/jumps/over/the/lazy/dog/.). Router top-6 expert selections identical to llama.cpp. Generation on the periodic prompt matches llama-completion 19/20 (one whitespace near-tie: 429 ' The' vs 185 '\n'+549). REWRITTEN deepseek.cpp (was dead unwired code written for a different GGUF variant): real bugs found & fixed — (a) missing q_a/kv_a latent RMSNorms, (b) expert block-offset bug (base never added → all blocks wrote the first 32 slots), (c) down-projection transposed read, (d) chunk→ADJACENT rope pairing (llama.cpp LLAMA_ROPE_TYPE_NORM), (e) exps stored [A innermost, expert outer] not experts-innermost, (f) shared experts fused [H, n_shared*MOE], (g) q_lora_rank=None → uncompressed attn_q, (h) dense layer 0 (first_k_dense=1, DI=10944 from tensor), (i) untied lm_head (output.weight), (j) scale 1/sqrt(192). KNOWN GAP: on weak random-text positions (model PPL ~21) the engine/numpy diverge from llama.cpp's argmax at some positions with non-trivial margins — an unresolved small detail (rope/yarn no-op confirmed, all layouts verified); the model is a degenerate base (echoes prompts) and both implementations echo. NOT claimed: clean 20/20 vs llama on arbitrary text. Memory: experts Q8→f16 (~29GB) vs f32 (~63GB). Gate: Testing/e2e_deepseek.cpp + /tmp/DeepSeek-V2-Lite.Q8_0.gguf.

engine ≡ HF-semantics numpy EXACT (all 6 layers + logits); top-1 logits == torch (253:1064.9 vs 1078.4 — flat distribution, near-tie tail); llama.cpp disagrees (neox-rope convention); degenerate tiny model — 20/20 gate not applicable

quirk_flags.pos: LEARNED embed_positions with +2 OFFSET (OPT pads 2 slots) — cfg.pos_offset

families.e2e_model: facebook/opt-125m (converted to safetensors locally; no HF safetensors exists)
families.oracle: torch (OPT in transformers 5.14; no GGUF available)
families.result: 20/20 tokens identical vs torch; torch-only harness fallback added to e2e_gen_check.py (no-GGUF tokenizer)

quirk_flags.qkv: separate q/k/v projs NO bias; out_proj bias yes
quirk_flags.window: local layers window 256 — no-op <256t, not implemented

families.result: 20/20 tokens identical vs torch; config uses num_layers/num_heads keys (reader fallbacks added)

quirk_flags.qkv: fused qkv_proj with mp_num=4 model-parallel layout [q(4h)|v(4h)|k(4h)] per shard — NOT [q|k|v]

families.result: engine ≡ corrected numpy EXACT (top-6 identical); same top-6 SET as torch with near-tie margins (0.01-0.6 logits, flat distribution); 3/20 chain (near-tie flips)
20/20 tokens identical vs torch, first try — adjacent partial rotary + parallel paths from codegen carried over

VALIDATED 2026-08-14: engine 20/20 generated tokens == numpy reference (port of authoritative modeling_gpt_oss.py) on the REAL openai/gpt-oss-20b checkpoint, full logits max|diff| 6.7e-5, top-8 EXACT. Engine keeps MXFP4 MoE packed (U8 blocks+scales, per-expert per-token dequant, ~17GB) — no torch reference needed. Quirks landed: YARN rope (theta 150000, factor 32, freq-index ramp), attention sinks (per-head logit cat before softmax), router bias, MXFP4 dequant (FP4 e2m1, value=FP4[nibble]*2^(scale-127), low->even/high->odd, 32/block), interleaved gate/up, gate=min(g,7) up=clamp(±7), glu=gate*sigmoid(1.702*gate), gated=(up+1)*glu, top-4 softmax gating, untied lm_head, head_dim 64, odd-safe rope. Known gap: sliding-window (128) attention on sliding layers — no-op < 128 tokens, unimplemented beyond (same class as gemma3 SWA).

quirk_flags.attention: GQA via num_attention_groups (groups==heads on validated ckpt)

families.result: VALIDATED 2026-08-15: 20/20 generated tokens == torch (modeling_step1.py fallback path, CPU f32), 16-position chain identical, full logits max|diff| 5.6e-5 top-8 EXACT. Quirks landed: sqrt-ALiBi attention (bias = -slope[h]*sqrt(pos-t), NO RoPE — cfg.alibi + per-head slope table built from build_alibi_cache convention), num_attention_groups -> n_kv_heads (reader), dense llama-layout (separate q/k/v/o, RMSNorm eps 1e-5, gated SwiGLU, no biases), untied-in-file lm_head. NOTE: 'Step1MoEForCausalLM' arch string + use_moe/moe_num_experts config but the weights are DENSE (no expert tensors) — the 2,882-checkpoint census class is mostly dense-mislabeled pretrain runs; expert-bearing Step1MoE ckpts not yet seen (defer moe_num_experts key until one is). Model itself is a mid-training run (LR 1.9e-3) — degenerate repeated-token output, engine==torch exactly.

quirk_flags.attention: fused query_key_value HEAD-INTERLEAVED [h(q,k,v)] + bias, linear ALiBi (no RoPE)

families.result: VALIDATED 2026-08-15: 20/20 generated tokens identical to torch (transformers 5.14 bloom, f32), full logits max|diff| 7.6e-4 corr 1.0 (bigscience/bloom-560m, /tmp/onebit-e2e/bloom). Quirks landed: RCPP_ARCH_BLOOM (31), fused query_key_value HEAD-INTERLEAVED (per-head [q,k,v] groups — NOT a [q|k|v] row split; modeling_bloom._reshape view(seq,heads,3,hd)), LayerNorm w+bias (input_layernorm + post_attention_layernorm, SEQUENTIAL), non-gated tanh-gelu FFN w/ bias (gelu_new), LINEAR ALiBi (same slope table as step1's sqrt variant — 2^(-8(h+1)/n) then 2^(-4(2h+1)/n) — but linear distance; softmax-equivalent to modeling_bloom's slope*pos_k cumsum trick), word_embeddings_layernorm (embedding LayerNorm, cfg.embed_ln), tied lm_head, config keys n_embed/n_head/n_layer/layer_norm_epsilon, 4x-hidden FFN fallback. First-pass bugs caught: wrong qkv split (row-split produced scrambled attention — hidden states 4.6x off at layer 0) and n_embed missing from the reader.
MAPPED 2026-08-16: VLM conditional-generation classes land on the QWEN35 token (text-decoder layout). Registry-only tier: no e2e gate yet — validates with the Qwen3.5 family bring-up.
MAPPED 2026-08-16: MAX-style text-decoder mapping (mistral3->MISTRAL, qwen2_5_vl->QWEN2VL, qwen3vlmoe->QWEN3VL, gemma4unified->GEMMA). Registry-only tier; vision tower unwired (documented).

VALIDATED 2026-08-15 (numpy-ref structural tier): engine hidden states == numpy port of modeling_glm4_moe.py at ALL positions (exact to 4-5 decimals) on tiny-Glm4MoeForCausalLM — sigmoid+correction-bias group-limited topk gating, norm_topk, routed_scaling 2.5, shared experts (mlp.shared_experts.*), per-head QK-norm, partial-rope 0.5 (rotary_dim rounded up to even per HF cat-double), first_k_dense dense layer 0. Final-logit corr 0.92 = f32 floor on the degenerate random-init checkpoint (all logits +/-0.036, pythia-70m situation); clean 20/20 needs the real GLM-4-32B-0414 (~70GB, deferred). Gate: python3 Testing/e2e_numpy_ref_glm4moe.py <dir> <ids> 10

VALIDATED 2026-08-15 (numpy-structural): engine hidden states corr 0.9999 vs numpy port of modeling_nemotron_h.py 5.14 on tiny-NemotronHForCausalLM-nano. New bespoke CPU backend src/nemotron_h_engine.cpp (per-layer layers_block_type dispatch: Mamba-2 mixer with Euler dB=dt*B discretization + causal depthwise conv (w[0]=oldest tap), NoPE GQA attention, relu2 MLP, sigmoid+correction-bias group-topk MoE with up/down-only experts + shared experts). Final-logit argmax flips on the degenerate random-init checkpoint (logits +/-0.06, pythia-70m situation); clean 20/20 needs a real Nemotron-H-4B/8B checkpoint. Gate: python3 Testing/e2e_numpy_ref_nemotronh.py <dir> <ids> 10

VALIDATED 2026-08-15 (numpy-structural): engine per-layer hidden states, attention probs/scores/acc EXACT vs numpy port of modeling_qwen3_next.py 5.14 on tiny-random/qwen3-next-moe (corr 0.9997, top-5 exact vs torch). New bespoke CPU backend src/qwen3next_engine.cpp (GatedDeltaNet delta-rule: in_proj_qkvz+in_proj_ba, causal depthwise conv w[0]=oldest, q/k l2norm + q scaled 1/sqrt(KHD), recurrent delta rule state*=exp(g), kv_mem, delta=(v-kv_mem)*beta, st+=k*delta, out=sum st*q; g=-exp(A_log)*softplus(a+dt_bias); norm DIRECT weight * silu(z); full attn q_proj [2*hd] INTERLEAVED q|gate split, q/k RMSNorm (1+w), partial rope, attn*sigmoid(gate); softmax router MoE + shared expert + sigmoid shared_gate). Argmax drifts on the degenerate random-init checkpoint (f32 vs f64 floor); clean 20/20 needs a real Qwen3-Next checkpoint (deferred). Gate: python3 Testing/e2e_numpy_ref_qwen3next.py <dir> <ids> 10

VALIDATED 2026-08-15 (FULL tier — real-logit model): engine 10-token chain == numpy ref EXACTLY, corr 1.0000, top-5 exact vs torch on tiny-random/minimax-m2. New bespoke CPU backend src/minimaxm2_engine.cpp: GQA attention with SINGLE RMSNorm over flattened q (NH*HD) and k (NKV*HD) dims (NOT per-head — q_norm/k_norm weights are full-dim), partial rope (rotary_dim 16, theta 5e6), pos-major KV cache; sigmoid MoE: router sigmoid + e_score_correction_bias, top-k on sigmoid+correction, weights from RAW sigmoid normalized (÷sum), gated w1/w2/w3 experts (silu(w1x)*(w3x) then w2). Clean 20/20 — the tiny model has real logit spread so argmax is exact. Gate: python3 Testing/e2e_numpy_ref_minimaxm2.py <dir> <ids> 10 == engine-gen

VALIDATED 2026-08-15 (FULL tier — real logit spread): engine 10-token chain == numpy ref EXACTLY, corr 1.0000, top-5 exact vs torch on tiny-Cohere2ForCausalLM. Rides the GENERIC engine (no bespoke backend): parallel_attn_ffn (attn+MLP from same input_layernorm output — falcon/codegen convention), mean-centered LayerNorm weight-only (layernorm_affine with b=NULL), adjacent-pair interleaved rope (matches rope_adjacent), gated SwiGLU, sliding-window attention, tied lm_head. arch selfcheck +cohere2/cohere2_model. Gate: python3 Testing/e2e_numpy_ref_cohere2.py <dir> <ids> 10 == engine-gen

VALIDATED 2026-08-15 (FULL tier — real logit spread): engine 10-token chain == numpy ref EXACTLY on yujiepan/falcon-h1-tiny-random, corr 1.0000, top-5 exact vs torch. New bespoke CPU backend src/falconh1_engine.cpp: Mamba-2 SSM mixer (ssm_in_multiplier, in_proj + mup_vector per-section multipliers, causal depthwise conv w[0]=oldest, Euler dB=dt*B, dt=softplus(dt+dt_bias), gated RMSNorm norm_before_gate=False) + GQA attention (k x key_multiplier, full rope) from the SAME normed input, each scaled (ssm_out/attn_out multipliers), residual, gated FFN (gate x gate_multiplier, out x down_multiplier), embeddings x embedding_multiplier, logits x lm_head_multiplier, tied lm_head. Clean 20/20 — the tiny model has real logit spread. Gate: python3 Testing/e2e_numpy_ref_falconh1.py <dir> <ids> 10 == engine-gen

VALIDATED 2026-08-16 (FULL tier — real logit spread): engine 3-token chain == numpy ref EXACTLY == torch EXACTLY ([156, 166, 782]) on a tiny RWKV-4 checkpoint (RwkvForCausalLM, hidden 16, 3 layers), corr 1.0000, top-5 exact vs torch. New bespoke CPU backend src/rwkv_engine.cpp: per-layer WKV recurrence (num/den/max state per channel, output=num/den with time_first, state update uses PRE-update num/den), token-shift time mixing (attn: key/value/receptance blend + sigmoid receptance gate; channel mixing: relu2 key, sigmoid receptance), mean-centered LayerNorm (weight+bias, NOT RMSNorm), untied head, inference weight rescale (output projections divided by 2^int(l/rescale_every) at load — transformers _rescale_layers). rwkv5/rwkv6/rwkv7 use different recurrences and deliberately stay UNKNOWN. Gate: engine 3-token chain == python3 Testing/e2e_numpy_ref_rwkv.py <dir> <ids> 3
